title: said.config.json
description: Per-repo defaults for Said & Done. Command-line flags always win; excluded sessions from both are combined. Relative paths are resolved against this file's folder.

sessionsDir.description: Read session files from this folder instead of ~/.claude/projects

since.description: Leave out prompts before this ISO date or time

until.description: Leave out prompts after this ISO date or time

excludeSessions.description: Session ids to leave out; an id prefix is enough

out.description: Where said build writes the page (default: build-story.html)

badgeOut.description: Where said badge writes the badge (default: said-badge.svg)
